SELECT substr(c.customer_phone, 1, 3) AS phone_prefix,
       substr(t.truck_licence_number, -2) AS licence_suffix,
       COUNT(*) AS frequency
FROM Customers c
JOIN Regular_Orders ro ON ro.distributer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON ao.regular_order_id = ro.regular_order_id
JOIN Order_Deliveries od ON od.actual_order_id = ao.actual_order_id
JOIN Trucks t ON t.truck_id = od.truck_id
GROUP BY phone_prefix, licence_suffix
ORDER BY frequency DESC
LIMIT 1;

votes.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    SUBSTR(c.customer_phone, 1, 4) AS phone_prefix,
    SUBSTR(t.truck_licence_number, LENGTH(t.truck_licence_number) - 3) AS license_ending
FROM Customers c
JOIN Regular_Orders ro ON c.customer_id = ro.distributer_id
JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON ro.regular_order_id = ao.regular_order_id
JOIN Order_Deliveries od ON ao.actual_order_id = od.actual_order_id
JOIN Trucks t ON od.truck_id = t.truck_id

WITH delivery_data AS (
    SELECT substr(c.customer_phone,1,3) AS phone_prefix,
           substr(t.truck_licence_number,-3) AS truck_ending,
           strftime('%Y', od.delivery_date) AS yr
    FROM Order_Deliveries od
    JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON od.actual_order_id = ao.actual_order_id
    JOIN Regular_Orders ro ON ao.regular_order_id = ro.regular_order_id
    JOIN Customers c ON ro.distributer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN Trucks t ON od.truck_id = t.truck_id
)
SELECT phone_prefix, truck_ending
FROM delivery_data
WHERE phone_prefix = truck_ending
GROUP BY phone_prefix, truck_ending
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT yr) > 1;
